translation.name: Scene Seongsu
translation.summary: A large cafe and select-shop space in Seongsu that also hosts pop-up events.
translation.description: Scene is a multi-use cafe space in the Seongsu cafe district. The first floor operates as a cafe and the upper level functions as a select shop, while the venue is also used for temporary pop-ups and brand events.
translation.local_tip: Because the space can host pop-ups, the atmosphere may change between visits. Check what is running when you plan your trip.
